title: Say 'I Got This' Under Panic, Watch Your Brain Spiral Faster
topic: Why Silently Using Your Own First Name Quiets Your Amygdala in 1 Second
act5_climax_episode: In 2017, Jason Moser and Ethan Kross combined millisecond scalp ERP and fMRI to prove silently switching from 'I' to your own first name drops emotional reactivity within 1 second and quiets the amygdala without burning prefrontal willpower.
